title: Beyond In-Distribution Metrics: A Systematic Out-of-Distribution Evaluation of Congenital Heart Disease Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.17068v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Congenital heart disease (CHD) diagnosis and surgical planning often require patient-specific 3D anatomical models, but manual segmentation is labor-intensive, particularly in complex anatomies. Although deep-learning methods can automate this process, they are typically evaluated in-distribution, despite clinically relevant shifts in scanner, protocol, institution, population, and imaging modality. We present, to our knowledge, the first systematic evaluation of out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in CHD segmentation, using ImageCHD as a held-out target cohort. We compare representative segmentation architectures under combined CT and CMR training, CT-only training, self-supervised pretraining, and limited target-domain adaptation. translated_title: 超越分布内指标：先天性心脏病分割的系统性分布外评估
translated_abstract: 先天性心脏病（CHD）的诊断和手术规划通常需要患者特异性的三维解剖模型，但手动分割非常耗费人力，尤其是在复杂解剖结构的情况下。尽管深度学习方法可以自动化这一过程，但它们通常仅在分布内进行评估，而忽略了临床上真实存在的扫描仪、协议、机构、人群和成像方式的差异。据我们所知，本研究首次对先天性心脏病分割中的分布外（OOD）泛化能力进行了系统性评估，并将ImageCHD作为留出的目标队列。我们比较了代表性分割架构在CT和CMR联合训练、仅CT训练、自监督预训练以及有限目标域适应等多种条件下的表现。结果表明，分布内性能是跨队列鲁棒性的一个糟糕指标：nnU-Net在验证集上达到了最高的Dice系数（0.77），但在ImageCHD上降至0.51，而SwinUNETR则表现出更好的泛化能力（摘要截断于此）。
tldr: 该研究首次系统性地评估了先天性心脏病分割模型的分布外泛化能力，发现分布内性能无法可靠预测跨队列鲁棒性——验证集上表现最好的nnU-Net在ImageCHD队列上Dice系数从0.77骤降至0.51。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first systematic out-of-distribution evaluation of congenital heart disease segmentation, revealing that in-distribution performance is a poor indicator of cross-cohort robustness, with top-performing nnU-Net dropping from 0.77 to 0.51 Dice on the ImageCHD cohort.
